notes: Blind reviewer, Gate 4, run 1927. Hook 1: a note-ban anniversary piece two days after 8 Nov that every outlet has run; the cover number is a nominal ten-year doubling, not a current lead. Facts re-checked: 28 Oct 2016 Rs 17,013.8 bn; 9 Dec 2016 Rs 7,809.5 bn and 23 Dec Rs 7,829.1 bn, so 'December 2016' is right and matches the caption; 15 Oct 2026 Rs 42,55,656 crore, +14.1%. Layout: full-bleed, sharp, white 3-line headline, 19 px gap to the vertical credit, not touching; slides 2-4 clean, with the template's vertical centring and no broken band; slide 3 bullet 1 ends just inside the margin.
